scope.object: the Yukawa couplings as bulk overlap integrals (L251 as stated)

claim_one_line: THE COUPLINGS AS BULK OVERLAPS OF FLUX ZERO MODES (L251 as stated; data-free): every allowed overlap is (Im tau)^(-1/4) theta[(a_p - a_q + m)/2, b_p - b_q](0, 2tau) up to a fixed phase (CIM's closed form, re-derived and checked on main); Wilson-line conservation gives B1636's parity pattern, but Y_pq^2 = (Im tau)^(-1/2) kappa_pq theta_p theta_q, i.e. Y_pq ~ eta^(3/2) theta_r^(-1/2), not B1636's theta_r^2 for any fixed Higgs and any matter Wilson lines (a q-expansion proof); B1642's residue coupling has theta_r^2 but is antisymmetric; the overlap depends on the legs' Wilson-line difference (q_L - q_R)w, at level 2, and is not B1656's flat-frame coupling. No input removed. 0 of 19.
